what: On first open, a thin 300px progress line under the logo on the background-color overlay fills 0→100% over 2s (power1.inOut — slow at the start and end) while the number below counts from 0% to 100% alongside it. When full, the whole overlay disappears in .5s power2.out and fires fx:done — the first video play and the scroll unlock hang on that

options.delay: Delay before counting starts (seconds), default 0 — Brand counts after .35s, when the app appears
options.prefix: Text before the number, separated from it by one space (e.g. ”Loading:” → Loading: 37%), none by default
options.done: Text to swap into the number slot after counting finishes (name etc.), default stays 100%
options.blink: Number of times the text in the number slot blinks after counting finishes (GSAP repeat, yoyo) — Name 4 turns off and on five times at 0.4s each for 2s, then turns back on over 0.4s power2.out as the curtain lifts. Default 0
options.hold: if true, waits with the curtain left up after counting (blinking) finishes — the caller sends fx:go to the element once images and video have arrived (sending it early means no waiting)
options.outease: Curve for the cover lifting away, default power2.out — Brand uses CSS ease(0.25,0.1,0.25,1)
options.unit: Unit after the number, default % — none shows only the number (large number at bottom right of a Brand site)
options.fx:counted: Event the element fires after counting (blinking) is done and just before the curtain lifts — with hold it waits here, so the caller finishes preparing and sends fx:go, starting the next scene (box entrance etc.) together

note: Progress line track is drawn by the user — the original is a 2px sand-colored track with golden fill. With reduced motion, fx:done fires immediately

from.where: index.html .loader — original value 0→100 2s power1.inOut, .loader opacity 0 .5s power2.out, when done the hero video plays · Lenis start

from.options: dur: 1.4; prefix: Loading:; done: Your name here; blink: 4; hold: true; out: .6; outease: 0.25,0.1,0.25,1
